name: feature-sourced-short
description: An open burlap sack of green (unroasted) coffee beans on a roastery floor, a hand scooping through them. Speaks to a short, known supply chain from named growers.

name: feature-roasted-weekly
description: Freshly roasted coffee beans cooling in the roaster's tray, warm brown and glossy, a dated bag nearby. Small-batch, roasted-this-week freshness.

name: feature-served-fresh
description: A barista making a careful pour-over at the café bar, steam rising, the same beans bagged on the shelf behind. Roasted in the room you drink it in.

name: about-roaster-at-work
description: The roaster at work in the back of a neighbourhood café, tending a small drum roaster, warm light and bags of green coffee around them. Hands-on, one-roaster-in-the-back character.

name: about-the-sourcing
description: Ripe red coffee cherries on the branch at a grower's farm, close and vivid. Represents a short list of trusted growers and real relationships.

name: about-roast-profiles
description: A roast profile curve on the roaster's control screen beside the drum roaster, a craftsperson dialling in a consistent roast. Consistency batch to batch.

name: about-the-counter
description: A barista chatting warmly with a customer across the café counter, whole-bean bags on display. The people who roast are the people who serve.

name: about-wholesale
description: Sealed, dated whole-bean wholesale bags stacked and ready for delivery to nearby cafés and offices. The weekly-roasted beans, packed for wholesale.

name: logo
description: Meridian Coffee Roasters wordmark logo, on a transparent or white background.
